nodes.label: R1: Remove self-serving review schema and rating claims — Google's structured-data policy treats self-marked reviews as self-serving and risks a manual action
R2: Refresh stale sitemap lastmod dates — stale lastmod misrepresents freshness to crawlers and erodes trust in the sitemap signal
R3: Real VideoObject dates/durations + missing sameAs — placeholder dates replaced with verified YouTube upload dates; GBP/LinkedIn/ORCID sameAs still blocked on human

R4: Cookie consent / Google Consent Mode v2 — GA4/Ads load unconditionally with no consent, a PECR/GDPR gap; because the GA4 snippet is duplicated inline across ~106 pages rather than a partial, step one must be extracting it into a partial before implementing consent once
R5: Merge duplicate form scripts — contact.js and landing-form.js were near-duplicates, so bug fixes historically landed in one but not the other
R6: Revisit CSS inlining vs cached stylesheet — inlining wins single-page bounce traffic, a linked stylesheet wins multi-page sessions and cuts repo churn; explicitly the owner's call, not an agent's
R7: Listen page audio, FAQ hub, per-page OG images — three content gaps, workable independently; image assets are blocked on the human owner
R8: Text contrast — an earlier audit flagged a borderline ratio, but measured properly it is 5.66:1, comfortably above WCAG AA; no change needed
R9: January demote seasonal Christmas nav + annual price date bump — Christmas was promoted to top-level nav for the booking season and should revert after, alongside a priceValidUntil bump

R9 (competitive capture): The London Funeral Singers — a sourced comparison page backed by a build gate so quoted competitor figures cannot go stale or be invented; surfaced two site-wide corrections, a false VAT-registration claim in 13 places and a false 'over 150 singers' roster claim in 13 places
R10: Two duplicate FAQ questions site-wide — the same FAQPage question string appearing on two pages splits the rich-result signal between them

R11: Replace the Victorian verification grep with an allowlist — a blanket empty-grep check for 'Victorian' can't distinguish legitimate historical or comparison uses from a costume-claim violation; the underlying no-costume rule is unweakened

R12: Testimonial pool reused across geographically mismatched pages — roughly 16 distinct testimonials are reused across 53 area/borough pages with mismatched named locations (e.g. 'Tony, Surrey' appears only on London borough pages); a business-integrity question left DECISION-NEEDED for the owner, and no new testimonial text may ever be invented to fill the gap

R13: Borough page template is a rigid, visible mould across all 33 pages — an identical H2 sequence and 3-question FAQ topic order on every borough page is exactly the structural sameness current Google quality guidance is trained to flag, independent of how good the sentence-level writing is; needs a template-level redesign, not a per-page copy fix
